verification_notes.note: Revised cost reduction figure to 'more than SEK 25 million annually' to match source precision (CEO states 'more than SEK 25 million on an annual basis'). Original draft implied exact SEK 25 million, which misrepresents the 'more than' qualifier in source.

redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. D1 (financial performance), D2 (key ratios), D3 (cost reduction strategy), D4 (product launches), D5 (target markets), D6 (liquidity/financing), D7 (financial instruments), and D8 (post-period events) each address distinct material facts without substantive overlap. D3's forward-looking cash flow target differs from D1's historical cash flow result.

key_information_units.information: Net sales decreased 35% to SEK 48,055,007 (SEK 74,497,775 in 2024) primarily due to timing shifts in customer orders; operating loss widened to SEK -32,380,175 (SEK -19,378,406 in 2024); net loss after tax was SEK -32,559,663 (SEK -19,150,134 in 2024) or SEK -0.25 per share (SEK -0.18); cash flow including financing activities turned positive to SEK 6,516,117 (SEK -12,758,133 in 2024).
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO’s comments: net sales SEK 48.1 million (-35% YoY), operating result SEK -32.0 million, net result SEK -32.56 million (EPS -0.25); cash flow SEK 6.52 million. Income statement and 2025 in figures confirm these figures.

key_information_units.information: Gross margin improved to 62% (57% in 2024) despite lower sales, while equity ratio declined to 71.8% (80.8% in 2024), indicating increased leverage.
key_information_units.source_evidence: 2025 in figures: Gross margin 62% (2024: 57%); Equity ratio 71.8% (2024: 80.8%) in key ratios table and multi-year summary.

key_information_units.information: The company completed its most development-intensive phase and shifted focus to commercial execution, reducing ongoing costs by more than 40% (corresponding to more than SEK 25 million annually) to target positive cash flow within twelve months.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO’s comments: 'implemented important changes to translate our technical position into concrete sales and established a structurally lower cost base, with the objective of reaching positive cash flow within the coming twelve months... reduced our ongoing costs by more than 40 percent, corresponding to more than SEK 25 million on an annual basis.'

key_information_units.information: The D2501 product (for smaller properties) is fully launched and integrated into Nokia’s Gigabit Connect platform, while the D2508 product (for medium/large multi-dwelling buildings) was launched through the company’s own channels and is planned for Nokia integration in summer 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO’s comments: 'our first product, D2501, is now fully launched in Nokia’s platform... we have launched D2508 through our own channels... planned to be integrated into Nokia’s platform... during the summer'. Business overview details D2501 and D2508 roles.

key_information_units.information: Key target markets include smaller multi-dwelling buildings, single-family housing areas, and large-scale projects in the United States where rapid, cost-effective broadband expansion is prioritized.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO’s comments: 'We see clear business opportunities for our MoCA Home solution in segments such as smaller multi-dwelling buildings and single-family housing areas, as well as in large-scale projects in the United States...'. Market overview confirms US and EU dynamics.

key_information_units.information: Cash and cash equivalents were SEK 8.7 million at year-end with the credit facility fully utilized; financing was strengthened by a directed share issue (SEK 33.5 million), convertible debentures (SEK 3.245 million), and a credit facility from Saugatuck Invest AB (up to SEK 20 million).
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO’s comments: 'At year-end, our cash and cash equivalents amounted to SEK 8.7 million and the credit facility was fully utilized.' Directors’ report details share issue, convertibles, and Saugatuck facility.

key_information_units.information: As of December 31, 2025, outstanding financial instruments included warrants totaling 1,692,955 shares and convertible debentures of SEK 3,245,786 convertible at SEK 1.72 per share.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Directors’ report: 'outstanding warrants as of 31 December amounted to 1,692,955... Convertible debentures... SEK 3,245,786... conversion price: SEK 1.72'.

key_information_units.information: Material post-reporting-period events include: a SEK 12.5 million convertible loan issued on January 19, 2026 (conversion price SEK 1.0, planned conversion in June 2027); three warrant programs (TO1-TO3) granted in January 2026; launch of the first Nokia-collaboration product at the start of 2026; and selection by Deutsche GigaNetz for in-building fiber extension in Germany.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 10: Lists 'convertible loan of SEK 12.5 million was issued on 19 January 2026... warrants (TO1: 18–29 May 2026, TO2: 16–30 September 2026, TO3: 18–29 January 2027)', 'Deutsche GigaNetz selects InCoax for in-building fiber extension in Germany', and 'At the beginning of 2026, our first product within the Nokia collaboration was launched'. CEO comments also reference the Nokia launch.
